#!/bin/bash
# Checkpoint rotation for detach_ln_s0/s1/s2 and cutoff_s2_v2
# Keeps only the latest checkpoint (by step number) per experiment
# Runs via cron every 30 minutes

LOG="/tmp/checkpoint_cleanup.log"
KEEP=1
DIRS=(
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s0
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s1
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s2
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/cutoff_s2_v2
)

echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === Cleanup run start ===" >> "$LOG"

for dir in "${DIRS[@]}"; do
    [ -d "$dir" ] || continue

    # Find all *_chkpt directories
    chkpts=$(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*_chkpt" | sort -t'-' -k1 -V)
    count=$(echo "$chkpts" | grep -c .)

    if [ "$count" -le "$KEEP" ]; then
        echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $dir: $count checkpoint(s), nothing to delete" >> "$LOG"
        continue
    fi

    delete_count=$((count - KEEP))
    echo "$chkpts" | head -n "$delete_count" | while read -r old; do
        size=$(du -sh "$old" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
        echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') DELETE $old ($size)" >> "$LOG"
        rm -rf "$old"
    done
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $dir: deleted $delete_count, kept $KEEP" >> "$LOG"
done

df -h /root/autodl-tmp >> "$LOG"
echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === Cleanup run end ===" >> "$LOG"
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/occsafe_vla/cleanup_old_checkpoints.sh

#!/bin/bash
# Checkpoint rotation for detach_ln_s0/s1/s2 and cutoff_s2_v2
# Keeps only the latest checkpoint (by step number) per experiment
# Runs in background loop, checks every 30 minutes

LOG="/tmp/checkpoint_cleanup.log"
KEEP=1
INTERVAL=1800
DIRS=(
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s0
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s1
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/detach_ln_s2
    /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/cutoff_s2_v2
)

while true; do
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === Cleanup run start ===" >> "$LOG"

    for dir in "${DIRS[@]}"; do
        [ -d "$dir" ] || continue

        chkpts=$(find "$dir" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name "*_chkpt" | sort -V)
        count=$(echo "$chkpts" | grep -c .)

        if [ "$count" -le "$KEEP" ]; then
            echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $dir: $count checkpoint(s), skip" >> "$LOG"
            continue
        fi

        delete_count=$((count - KEEP))
        echo "$chkpts" | head -n "$delete_count" | while read -r old; do
            size=$(du -sh "$old" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
            echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') DELETE $old ($size)" >> "$LOG"
            rm -rf "$old"
        done
        echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') $dir: deleted $delete_count, kept $KEEP" >> "$LOG"
    done

    df -h /root/autodl-tmp >> "$LOG"
    echo "$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === Cleanup run end ===" >> "$LOG"
    sleep $INTERVAL
done
